summary.result: Overall, the results of the experimental wetland system was encouraging, and it can be considered as one of the practical alternatives for rural domestic wastewater treatment in Korea.
summary.background: A field experiment of wetland system was performed from August 1996 to August 1997 to treat the domestic wastewater in Chon-Ahn, Korea.
summary.method: Further research is recommended to reduce nutrients in the effluent.
